stories.title: Anthropic pitches AI safety bill that may block a model if 50+ people could be killed
stories.take: Anthropic's draft would let a model be blocked over mass-harm risk — but only with a judge's sign-off, so agencies can't pull one on their own.

stories.title: SpaceX and Tesla boards form special committees to review merger
stories.take: Both boards set up independent-director committees to review a SpaceX-Tesla merger; Musk says he likes the idea but sits on neither committee.

stories.title: OpenAI acquires startup Orchestra Bio⁠ to beef up its biotech business
stories.take: OpenAI is folding Orchestra Bio's team into Rosalind, its life-sciences model, to help researchers plan experiments and read results.

stories.title: Google is bringing a more personal version of its Gemini AI assistant to your car
stories.take: Gemini's Personal Intelligence heads to cars, pulling from Gmail, Calendar, Maps and YouTube to answer with your own context while you drive.

stories.title: The Internet goes on high alert after discovery of 8 compromised TLS certs
stories.take: Eight compromised intermediate TLS certificates could let anyone mint credentials for any site — browsers and operators are scrambling to revoke them.

stories.title: Meta’s Muse hits 10M U.S. downloads in 40 days, a milestone reached by only 11 other apps
stories.take: Muse passed 10 million US downloads in 40 days, a pace only 11 apps have hit, and it's holding users better than rival AI companions.

stories.title: Netflix Lowers Expected Ad Revenue After Slower Rollout of Capabilities
stories.take: Netflix cut its ad target from $3B to $2.7B for the year after its new measurement and buying tools rolled out slower than planned.

stories.title: Salesforce to Buy Braze for $5.66 Billion
stories.take: Salesforce is buying Braze for $5.66B to feed real-time customer-behavior signals into its marketing AI and content optimization.

stories.title: Publicis agrees to preserve LiveRamp’s neutrality. Will it matter?
stories.take: The FTC deal lets Publicis buy LiveRamp for $2.2B only with nondiscriminatory access and firewalls — and some rivals are already pulling back anyway.

stories.title: Courvoisier’s first global campaign in years embraces house party culture
stories.take: Courvoisier's first global push in years leans into house-party culture across social, TV, retail and OOH as cognac tries to recover from its COVID boom fade.

stories.title: Apple finally explains its Safari block, and identity companies are in its sights
stories.take: Apple spelled out why it blocks identity companies in Safari — just as its own growing ads business puts that blocklist under new scrutiny.

stories.title: "Is this what designers need to do to find work in 2026?" a viral high-production video has sparked debate
stories.take: A designer's slick, high-production job-hunt video went viral and split the industry: personality and storytelling land, but should getting hired take a film shoot?

stories.title: Follow live: LeBron James makes 76ers debut against defending champion Knicks
stories.take: Opening Night headliner is live: LeBron debuts for Philadelphia at Madison Square Garden against the defending-champion Knicks.

stories.title: George's 38 not enough as Pistons rally to defeat Celtics
stories.take: Paul George scored 38 in his Celtics debut, but Detroit rallied late to beat Boston 121-113 in the season opener.

stories.title: Dybantsa debut delayed: No. 1 pick out opener due to ankle
stories.take: No. 1 pick AJ Dybantsa will miss Washington's opener Wednesday with an ankle injury, delaying the most-watched debut of the class.

stories.title: Karl-Anthony Towns confirms he's willing to take less money from Knicks amid halted contract extension talks
stories.take: Towns says a max deal was 'nowhere' in his mind in talks with New York — he's willing to take less while extension talks sit halted.

stories.title: Timberwolves agree to 1-year, $40M extension with McDaniels
stories.take: Minnesota locked in Jaden McDaniels on a one-year, $40M extension, keeping him under contract through 2029-30.

stories.title: NBA Power Rankings: Spurs begin the season as No. 1 team, Knicks lead a reloaded East
stories.take: CBS opens the year with San Antonio at No. 1 and the Knicks atop a reloaded East as the 2026-27 season tips off.

stories.title: The World Series matchup is set! How Rays, Brewers can win it all
stories.take: It's Rays vs. Brewers for a first-ever title either way — Game 1 is Friday, and ESPN maps how each club can win it.

stories.title: Caminero's unlikely blast, 38.7-second HR trot punctuate Rays' pennant-clinching win
stories.take: Junior Caminero's first postseason homer, off Cleveland closer Cade Smith, sealed Tampa Bay's pennant — and he took a 38.7-second trot to enjoy it.

stories.title: 'Fastball Freddy' Peralta named ALCS MVP after pitching Rays into World Series
stories.take: Freddy Peralta rode his fastball to ALCS MVP, pitching the Rays past Cleveland and into the World Series.

stories.title: Three X-factors that could shape the 2026 World Series: Infield defense, Bryan Baker's fastball and more
stories.take: CBS picks the swing factors for Friday's opener in Milwaukee: infield defense, Bryan Baker's fastball, and the margins between two balanced clubs.

stories.title: Boone returning as Yankees manager in 2027, source says
stories.take: Aaron Boone will return for a 10th season as Yankees manager in 2027, ending the annual will-they-move-on speculation early.

stories.title: MLB qualifying offer for free agents rises to $23.15M, up 5.1% from 2025
stories.take: This winter's qualifying offer is $23.15M, up 5.1% from last year — the price tag that will shape the top of the free-agent market.

stories.title: Florida kills 77-year-old man in state’s 18th execution of year
stories.take: Florida executed 77-year-old Vietnam veteran William Reaves, its 18th execution this year, despite fellow veterans urging DeSantis to halt it.

stories.title: Michael Bloomberg spends $80m on Democrats as Trump moves $400m to Republican candidates
stories.take: Bloomberg is putting $80M into House races to help Democrats retake the majority, while Trump says he'll spend $400M on Republicans, $300M already out.

stories.title: US has resumed sharing intelligence with Ukraine about Russian strikes, says Zelenskyy
stories.take: Zelenskyy says US warnings on Russian missile strikes are flowing again after a White House pause last week: 'Now it works. It's great.'

stories.title: Zelenskyy seeks to mend ties with Trump ahead of Witkoff-Putin meeting
stories.take: Zelenskyy met envoy Steve Witkoff and European officials in Norway to ease tensions with Trump before Witkoff sits down with Putin.

stories.title: How the Kansas Senate race became surprisingly competitive
stories.take: Kansas hasn't elected a Democratic senator since 1932, but pastor Adam Hamilton has made Sen. Roger Marshall's race a genuine fight, and Trump campaigned there Monday.

stories.title: FAA approves Boeing's 737 Max 10 for passenger service
stories.take: The FAA cleared Boeing's 737 Max 10 for passenger service — a bigger, more fuel-efficient model airlines want with jet fuel costs high.

stories.title: Storms descend on Southern California, raising risk of dangerous surf, flooding, debris flows
stories.take: Storms are hitting Southern California with a 30-40% thunderstorm chance and minor flooding and debris-flow risk across LA and Ventura counties.

stories.title: Huge crack along PCH near Laguna Beach will take at least $4 million to fix, officials say
stories.take: Caltrans secured emergency funding, at least $4M, to fix a huge crack in the slope below PCH near Crystal Cove's Moro Beach.

stories.title: Thousands of California voters got duplicate vote-by-mail ballots. Here's what happened
stories.take: Thousands of voters in a Central Valley town got two mail ballots; the registrar blames a printing error and says only one will count.

stories.title: Feds hold back an additional $1.2 billion in California Medicaid reimbursements
stories.take: Washington deferred another $1.2B in California Medicaid money, on top of $1.3B held in May over hospice and in-home care concerns.

stories.title: California state workers are about to strike. What that means for the DMV, EDD, parks and more
stories.take: The state's largest state-worker union strikes this week, which could slow the DMV, EDD, parks and other everyday services.

stories.title: Rick Caruso has 'extreme concern' over Raman, but declines to endorse in mayor's race
stories.take: Caruso again declined to endorse Bass or Raman in the Nov. 3 LA mayoral runoff, but said he has 'extreme concern' over Raman's plan to remove the police chief.

stories.title: Blackstone Hauls in $8.7 Billion for Energy Transition Fund
stories.take: Blackstone raised $8.7B for an energy-transition fund focused on power and infrastructure — transmission, data centers and supplies, not just clean energy • Private-credit respondents rank power the top investment area, ahead of GPUs and real estate; Apollo puts the transition plus power opportunity at $60–80T • Buffett paused gifts to the Gates Foundation; his three children will now direct the $150B philanthropy, each with a distinct focus

stories.title: JB Pritzker thinks AI could help us live to 100 — or threaten us like nukes
stories.take: Pritzker's answer in one line: his kids, 21 and 24, will live to 100–110 on AI-driven medical breakthroughs — and AI is also 'potentially existential,' like nukes, needing guardrails modeled on non-proliferation • He warns baseline unemployment could rise from 4% to 7–10% with gains concentrated in very few hands • Only Illinois, California and New York have passed AI safety acts; he calls the state-by-state patchwork the wrong way to do it

stories.title: The Kansas Senate race is looking like a toss up. Yes, really.
stories.take: Yes, really — a toss-up: Democrat Adam Hamilton, a Methodist pastor, is tied or slightly ahead of Republican Sen. Roger Marshall, and both parties are pouring in millions • Kansas has not elected a Democratic senator since 1932 and Trump won it by 16 points; Marshall underperformed Trump in 2020 • Hamilton out-raised Marshall $10M to under $1M last quarter; affordability, health care and farm/trade costs drive voters

stories.title: Why The Stock Market Is Booming — But Your Paycheck Isn't
stories.take: The answer: corporate earnings are up ~40% since 2017 while real wages fell 0.7% year-on-year for a sixth straight month — the boom bypasses paychecks • Wealth is K-shaped by age: households 75+ are up 37% since 2022, under-35s down 23%; the top 10% drive 50% of consumption • Meta cut 8,000 jobs to buy GPUs; the hosts' bottom line is automate equity investing and vote, because AI capex flows to asset owners, not workers

stories.title: Inside Putin’s Plan to Cripple Ukraine This Winter
stories.take: A captured Russian plan targets Kyiv, Kharkiv and Odesa to cut electricity by 90% and heating by up to 90% this winter, making civilian life unbearable to force surrender pressure • Ukraine's ballistic-missile interception rate has fallen from 30–40% to about 10% as Patriot supply was diverted, and new jet-powered drones fly ~370 mph • More than 100 civilians were killed in the first week of October; Kyiv reports throttled Starshield terminals and missed US satellite warnings, which Washington denies

stories.title: Why your favorite creator is building an app
stories.take: The answer: creators are vibe-coding apps with Claude Code — prompting AI to write, test, package and ship end-to-end while they act as project managers who cannot read the SwiftUI • Two types: free micro-tools built in ~2 hours (Leveler, Captioner, Transcriber, Coffee Finder) and CanDo, a $3 Kanban app that gates feedback and recoups ~$1k in token costs • AI also handles screenshots, release notes and TestFlight via App Store Connect and Cloudflare API keys

stories.title: Trump Eases Russia Sanctions, Midterm Campaign Money, Violent Protests In France
stories.take: Trump waived congressionally mandated Russia sanctions he had signed, as Ukraine hit St. Petersburg oil terminals in its largest drone attack since 2022 and Russian strikes killed at least 11 • The midterms are shaping up as the most expensive ever at over $15B raised; Democrats lead grassroots fundraising while Elon Musk gave $158M to the Senate Leadership Fund plus $89M to his own America PAC • France's student protests exploded into nationwide riots: ~2,300 arrested and nearly 1,000 police injured

stories.title: Saudi Arabia Postpones ‘Davos in the Desert’ After Houthi Attacks
stories.take: Saudi Arabia postponed its Future Investment Initiative to next year after Houthi attacks on Riyadh airport; senior executives including Jamie Dimon and Jane Fraser were unwilling to fly in • The PIF event, chaired by Mohammed bin Salman, is the hallmark of his economic plan — its delay shows regional conflict jeopardizing that plan • Also: Musk pledged a SpaceX share to every US child (~73 million, ~$10B), and pharma's protein-degrader drugs move into asthma and Parkinson's trials

stories.title: Violent Rioting Sweeps France
stories.take: School protests in poor Paris suburbs spread into nationwide rioting — looting, arson and a collapsed city-hall bell tower in Le Creusot • Macron cannot use cash handouts this time: deficits are over 5% and markets press for cuts, leaving a security crackdown with too few police • Marine Le Pen gains as 'France in decline' images spread; also, Putin floated a Trump-Xi summit on Ukraine that would exclude Kyiv, and Anthropic committed 5% of shares to a public-benefit fund ahead of a possible IPO
